items.what: Pstruh obecný (brown trout) — trophy fish from the 2022 stocking photo; the shop sells this species as 'Liběchovský potočák'
items.source: lihenlibechov.cz/uploads/images/632b618a081b8172055605.jpg (1600×1200) → Higgsfield upscale 4k (job 0528c9f5…) → ISNet + GrabCut (second fish + third tail removed) + 1.5 px edge shrink + colour decontamination
items.notes: Curled body, tail partly hidden in the source (tail ends blunt) → best in motion (swim-through, macro push-in on the spots/eye), not as a static full-frame packshot. Do not call it 'Liběchovský potočák' on screen without context: the photo is from stocking trophy brown trout (aktualita 'Nasadili jsme 21.9.').

REAL brown trout (pstruh obecný), straight side-on, from the Líheň Liběchov web — replaces the AI-upscaled, bent h2_trout_potocak in the "donedávna" frame
items.processing: hand-traced outline snapped to the photo edge (Lab gradient, ±10 px, smoothed); fingers on the belly/back replaced by a column-wise copy of the fish’s own neighbouring belly/back texture (aligned to the body edge, colour-matched, 5 px feather) + Telea on thin rims; no upscale, no generative fill. The far pectoral fin (hidden behind the left hand) is left out.
items.pose: side-on, straight, head left, belly down; snout at x≈6, tail tip at x≈1179 (canvas px)
items.use: native 1:1 or smaller (max 1.3x per BLOCK_API); never through an AI upscaler
